review.body: { let Value :: Array (fields) = value else { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } ; if fields . as_slice () . len () != 11 { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } let Value :: Bytes (point) = & fields . as_slice () [1] else { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } ; let retirement_point = point . as_slice () . try_into () . map_err (| _ | ProfileError :: Representation) ? ; let original = array (fields . as_slice () . iter () . enumerate () . filter (| (i , _) | * i != 1) . map (| (_ , value) | value . clone ()) ,) ; let body = ProposalBody { structural : super :: body_from_projection (& original) ? , retirement_point , } ; if body_projection (& body) ? != * value { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } Ok (body) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
